title: Glowing magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='28' fill='#3a1a6e' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='20' fill='#5a2a8e' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='14' fill='#7b3fbf' opacity='0.3'/>
  
  <!-- sparkle rays -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='14' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='56' x2='50' y2='62' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='23' y1='35' x2='29' y2='35' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='71' y1='35' x2='77' y2='35' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='31' y1='16' x2='35' y2='20' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='50' x2='69' y2='54' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='69' y1='16' x2='65' y2='20' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='31' y1='54' x2='35' y2='50' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- star at tip -->
  <polygon points='50,20 53,29 62,29 55,34 58,43 50,38 42,43 45,34 38,29 47,29' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <polygon points='50,23 52,29 58,29 53,33 55,39 50,35 45,39 47,33 42,29 48,29' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  
  <!-- wand stick -->
  <rect x='46' y='40' width='8' height='48' rx='4' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <rect x='46' y='40' width='4' height='48' rx='4' fill='#a8754e'/>
  
  <!-- wand handle band -->
  <rect x='44' y='70' width='12' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <rect x='44' y='70' width='12' height='3' rx='2' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  
  <!-- handle end cap -->
  <rect x='45' y='84' width='10' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <rect x='45' y='84' width='5' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  
  <!-- small stars floating -->
  <polygon points='30,28 31,31 34,31 32,33 33,36 30,34 27,36 28,33 26,31 29,31' fill='#fff9c4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <polygon points='72,45 73,47 75,47 73.5,48.5 74.5,51 72,49.5 69.5,51 70.5,48.5 69,47 71,47' fill='#fff9c4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <polygon points='68,18 69,21 72,21 70,23 71,26 68,24 65,26 66,23 64,21 67,21' fill='#ffe66d' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- bottom sparkles -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='92' r='2' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='86' r='1' fill='#ffd700'/>
</svg>
